  public static HashMap<String,String> fromJsonParser(String jsonString){
    
    HashMap<String,String> parsedResultMap = new HashMap<String,String>();
    try{
      //Below (String, Pattern, Matcher) are the regex strings and their patterns and matcher used to process a jsonString
    
        // topLevelString is the regex representing the topLevel class name
        String topLevelString = "\\{\\\"[A-Z]\\w*\\\":";
        Pattern topLevelPattern = Pattern.compile(topLevelString);
        Matcher topLevelMatcher = topLevelPattern.matcher(jsonString);
        String quotes="\\\"";
        
        if(topLevelMatcher.find()){
            //actual string that represent the topLevel className
            String topLevelStringFound=topLevelMatcher.group(0);
            String className=topLevelStringFound.split(quotes)[1];
            parsedResultMap.put("className", className);
            // The object's own "key":value pairs follow, a value being a "string", a [list] or an {object}.
            // Each value is skipped whole, so the pairs of an associated object are left for that object to read
            int pairStart=topLevelMatcher.end()+1;
            while(pairStart<jsonString.length()&&jsonString.charAt(pairStart)=='"'){
              int keyEnd=jsonString.indexOf('"',pairStart+1);
              int valueEnd=keyEnd<0?-1:fromJsonParserValueEnd(jsonString,keyEnd+2);
              if(valueEnd<0){
                break;
              }
              String key=jsonString.substring(pairStart+1,keyEnd);
              String value=jsonString.substring(keyEnd+2,valueEnd);
              if(value.startsWith("\"")){
                value=value.substring(1,value.length()-1).replace("\\\\","\\").replace("\\\"","\"");
              }
              // the class name and object id come first and win over an attribute named like them
              parsedResultMap.putIfAbsent(key,value);
              // skip the comma, and the extra one left by a superclass with nothing to output
              pairStart=valueEnd;
              while(pairStart<jsonString.length()&&jsonString.charAt(pairStart)==','){
                pairStart++;
              }
            }
        }
        return parsedResultMap;
    }catch(NullPointerException e){
      return parsedResultMap;
    }
  }
   
  public static String fromJsonParserHelper(String jsonString, String regexString){
    String umpleID = "";
    String quo="\\\"";
    try{
      Pattern umpleIDPattern=Pattern.compile(regexString);
      Matcher umpleIDMatcher=umpleIDPattern.matcher(jsonString);

        }
      }
      return umpleID;
    } catch(NullPointerException e){
      return umpleID;
    }
  }
   
  public static List<String> fromJsonParserList(String objListString){
    List<String> objList=new ArrayList<String>();
    try{
      // objListString is a [list] of {objects}, each taken whole with the objects nested in it
      int objStart=1;
      while(objStart<objListString.length()&&objListString.charAt(objStart)=='{'){
        int objEnd=fromJsonParserValueEnd(objListString,objStart);
        if(objEnd<0){
          break;
        }
        objList.add(objListString.substring(objStart,objEnd));
        objStart=objEnd+1;
      }
      return objList;
   }catch(NullPointerException e){
     return objList;
   }
  }
   
  public static String fromJsonParserClassName(String objNameString){

  /*
  * Returns the index just after the json "string", [list] or {object} that starts at index start,
  * or -1 if there is none there or it is cut short.
  * Brackets and escaped quotes inside a string are text, so they do not end the value
  */
  private static int fromJsonParserValueEnd(String jsonString, int start){
    if(start>=jsonString.length()||"\"[{".indexOf(jsonString.charAt(start))<0){
      return -1;
    }
    int depth=0;
    boolean inString=false;
    for(int i=start;i<jsonString.length();i++){
      char c=jsonString.charAt(i);
      if(inString){
        if(c=='\\'){
          i++;
        }
        else if(c=='"'){
          inString=false;
        }
      }
      else if(c=='"'){
        inString=true;
      }
      else if(c=='{'||c=='['){
        depth++;
      }
      else if(c=='}'||c==']'){
        depth--;
      }
      if(!inString&&depth==0){
        return i+1;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }
